why: This is not a loop: the diff shows three features landing one after another on the same page, each adding a separate set of notes. 343 adds the Morse notes and the entrance-ground absence note, 336 adds the Takayama notes and the Edo-plan absence note, and 338 (working tree) adds takayama-jinya-city and middle-gate-office-absence. 338 removes nothing, nothing oscillates and no finding is REVERSING. The cap fired because the round counter counts one page across features, not because a check repeated; round 3 is the first and only reading of 338's notes, so accepting would close 0104 with two notes no one has read.

Round 4 is not a cycling check: it exists because three already-registered pages (wheatbaku-machibugyosho-yashiki, kazusa-bugyosho, orange-hatchobori-yoriki) were found to contradict item A's committed absence sentence, and the bullet was rewritten to 'Graveled, at Edo' on their strength. That is a NEW and material claim, carried by three notes no source-reader round has yet checked; no finding is REPEATED or REVERSING, and the event log shows no oscillation. Accepting would close the page on three unverified citations and a narrowed absence note, so one bounded round is worth its cost.

The bundle kept no source-reader reply for rounds 1-4, so this ruling rests on the diffs between rounds, not on findings; it also does not say what the two earlier round-arbiter dispatches (23:37:56, 23:51:51) were asked or ruled. In those diffs the check edits that owe this re-reading put no new claim from a source on 0104: entrance-ground-surface-absence only lost sentences, the drawing page's morse-1886-homes copies a passage the 0104 notes have carried since 998fa3982, orange-hatchobori-yoriki gained a bracketed gloss, and kazusa-bugyosho's one new passage (#4, quote-verbatim VERBATIM) backs the attribution to Hara that the note already made. Nothing reverses or oscillates, and a fifth reading of text that is narrower or already read costs more than it can find.
